summary: Modern semantic retrieval can compensate for imperfect structure, so reorganizing a mature repository solely for an agent may cost more than it returns.

points.text: Search, language servers, dependency graphs and repository indexes can recover relationships without forcing feature-folder locality.
Large structural migrations create merge risk and human retraining cost; a small maintained project map may deliver most of the value.
The strongest studies evaluate code retrieval benchmarks, not long-running teams maintaining mixed code, documentation and operations artifacts.
